title: Sky: Juventus open preliminary Sancho talks with Man United
content:
Sky Sport Italia reports that Juventus have resumed their interest in Manchester United winger Jadon Sancho, opening preliminary talks with the Red Devils.

Juventus have joined Napoli in the race for England international Sancho, opening preliminary talks with his club, Manchester United.

WROCLAW, POLAND – MAY 28: Jadon Sancho of Chelsea celebrates his team’s victory at full time following the UEFA Conference League Final 2025 between Real Betis Balompie and Chelsea FC at Stadion Wroclaw on May 28, 2025 in Wroclaw, Poland. (Photo by Richard Heathcote/Getty Images)

The former Chelsea loanee has returned to Old Trafford after a one-season spell at Chelsea, where he scored five goals and provided ten assists in 41 appearances across all competitions.

According to Sky transfer expert Gianluca Di Marzio, Juventus talks are currently more oriented towards United than the player’s camp.

LONDON, ENGLAND – MARCH 16: Jadon Sancho of Chelsea lies behind the defensive wall to act as a draft excluder for an Arsenal free kick during the Premier League match between Arsenal FC and Chelsea FC at Emirates Stadium on March 16, 2025 in London, England. (Photo by Julian Finney/Getty Images)

Juventus already held talks for Sancho a year ago, when Cristiano Giuntoli was in charge of the Old Lady’s transfers.

PARMA, ITALY – MAY 18: Antonio Conte, Head Coach of Napoli, looks on prior to the Serie A match between Parma and Napoli at Stadio Ennio Tardini on May 18, 2025 in Parma, Italy. (Photo by Alessandro Sabattini/Getty Images)

Napoli remain interested in Sancho as well, as Antonio Conte is looking for two new attacking wingers for the 2025-26 season.

Football Italia understands that the Partenopei are currently in talks with Bologna for Dan Ndoye and have targeted Liverpool wantaway Federico Chiesa.
